title: Noise-induced stabilization of Schwarzschild--AdS black holes under stochastic Ricci flow
summary: We investigate the stochastic Ricci flow of spherically symmetric perturbations of the Schwarzschild--Anti de Sitter black-hole metric. Elaborating on the Ricci-flow analysis of Headrick and Wiseman, we include a negative cosmological constant through a Ricci-target term and study how the flow is correlated with the thermodynamic heat capacity of the black hole.
